capabilities: Open internal links in a new tab, split, or popout window by default
Scroll same-note heading and block links in the current tab instead of duplicating it
Focus an existing tab when the target note is already open
Invert Cmd/Ctrl+click to open links in the current tab
Respect popout windows and multi-window layouts
extras: Part of an author plugin suite (DoomEsque theme, Whole-Tree Search, Task Docket, and others) aimed at fully offline use; the README warns that Obsidian's own Sync, Publish and update features must also be disabled for a fully offline setup.
intentEvidence: to open in a new tab by default instead of replacing the current tab
motivation: The author built the surrounding plugin suite so notes could be used offline with zero network traffic during open-book law exams.
problem: Obsidian replaces the current tab when you click an internal link, which loses your place while browsing notes.

relations.evidence: Built with monkey-around to cooperate cleanly with other plugins hooking workspace.openLinkText

summary: Link-opening modifier that makes internal links open in a new tab by default, with tab reuse and same-note anchor handling.
